name: jailbreaks
one_liner: A personal collection of system prompts people use to try to get AI chatbots to ignore their safety rules.
buyer: No legitimate buyer. This is a plain-text list of prompt-injection and persona-lock text for researchers and curious tinkerers, not a tool a business would pay for.
business_use_cases: An AI safety researcher reads it as a reference of real-world jailbreak patterns when testing how resistant their own model or product is to instruction override.
A company building an LLM-based product uses the collection as a red-team test set to probe their own guardrails before launch.

money_ideas.idea: None that are legitimate as a product built on this repo directly — any commercial use would be adjacent (AI red-teaming/safety services), not the list itself.

steal_this: There's nothing to build or sell from this repo itself; it's a curiosity and a liability risk, not a business opportunity. If anything, use it only internally as a red-team checklist for your own product's guardrails, never as something to publish or resell.
